card: Deletes the `removeprunedfunds` RPC (which was deprecated in v32) and completely removes transaction deletion code from the wallet database and memory models. In addition, legacy wallet migration will no longer delete watchonly transactions from the migrated wallet, leaving harmless non-owned transactions intact rather than running database deletion routines. This cleans up unused and dangerous transaction-removal infrastructure across the wallet subsystem.
changed_since_previous: Diff is now available; implementation and scope remain unchanged from the previous description.
evidence: PR description: 'Deprecated in v32 (https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35605), this deletes the useless and harmful `removeprunedfunds` RPC.'

PR description: 'AFAICT for both GUI and RPC having irrelevant transactions inside of wallet is harmless and does not affect the output of anything, since most stuff is gated behind IsMine() anyways.'
Commit df1f84d459: 'There is never a good reason to delete tx data from a wallet, so delete these functions.'
problem: Maintaining wallet transaction deletion functionality adds unnecessary complexity and potential footguns. The `removeprunedfunds` RPC was deprecated in v32, and removing watchonly transactions from migrated wallets adds complexity for no practical benefit since unowned transactions do not affect balance calculations.

risk.why: Alters RPC surface by removing `removeprunedfunds` and changes wallet migration behavior to retain unowned watchonly transactions, which are visible via `gettransaction` if txid is known.

summary: Deletes the deprecated `removeprunedfunds` RPC method and removes all underlying transaction deletion logic from the wallet (`CWallet::RemoveTxs` and `WalletBatch::EraseTx`). It also stops pruning watchonly transactions from the main wallet during legacy-to-descriptor wallet migration.
